questions.question: Which factor is the MOST important reason to choose an Azure region close to your users?

options.text: Lower latency for a faster user experience
It removes the need for backups

options.why: Resources are billed in every region.

questions.explanation: Nearby regions reduce network latency; also consider residency, service availability and price.

questions.question: What happens to planned Azure updates in a region pair?

options.text: They are applied to one region of the pair at a time
They are applied to both regions at exactly the same time

questions.explanation: Region pairs receive planned updates sequentially.

questions.scenario: A company in China needs to run workloads that comply with Chinese regulations.
questions.question: Which option should it use?

options.why: Correct. It is a sovereign instance of Azure in China.
Azure Government is for US government agencies.

options.text: Any public Azure region in Europe
options.why: This does not meet Chinese requirements.
Zones are inside regions; they do not address sovereignty.

questions.explanation: Sovereign regions include Azure Government (US) and Azure operated by 21Vianet (China).
